description: Woven meshes and textile facings for the 'mesh' element. Every entry states its value, method, physical state, tolerance, status, source and licence. 'status' is one of: measured, datasheet, estimated, unverified. Parameters use the element's unit-suffixed keys.

entries.method: manufacturer datasheet (air-flow resistance, MKS rayl; grade number equals rayl)
entries.tolerance: not stated by the supplier; industry practice assumes 10-15 % (spec Section 13)
entries.source: Saati Acoustex range end point as quoted in the AcoustiLab v2 spec, Section 13 (p. 46); the Saati datasheet itself was not consulted in this work
entries.licence: facts quoted from a public datasheet
